  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 24, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on October 24, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on October 10, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of The City of Inglewood to host a Women’s March and Rally Event
  at 1 W. Manchester Blvd., Inglewood City Hall – South Lawn, Public Property, on Saturday,
  November 02, 2024 from 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event at City Hall
  South Lawn; IDP will deploy one (1) Sergeant, two (2) police officers for public safety and
  four (4) TCO’s for intermittent traffic control.Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State Health
  Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00385418)

Item #2:  Daniel Medina on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a 2024 Dia De los Muertos Art
  Exhibition Event at 111 N. Locust Street, Inglewood Senior Center, Public Property, on
  Saturday, November 02, 2024 from 1:00 pm – 5:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event at Inglewood

Item #3:  Ernest Kevin Supertran on behalf of First Chapter Deveopment, Inc., to host a Temporary
  Costco Special Event to Sell Duplicate Auto Keys at 3560 W Century Blvd, from
  Wednesday, November 13, 2024 through, Sunday, December 08, 2024, from, 10:00 a.m.
  – 8:30 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Approval multiple day event within Costco building and parking lot;
  Applicant shall coordinate security staffing with Costco for the safety of the employee that
  will be making keys in the parking lot;;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this
  event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State Health
  Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00385431).

Item #4:  Betty Luckett on behalf of From the Heart Preschol to host a From The Heart preschool
  Harvest Festival Event at 1061 E Hyde Park Blvd Private Property / Public Property, on
  Friday, November 01, 2024, from, 4:00 p.m .- 6:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for one (1) day event on Long
  Street; Applicant to have off-duty aw Enforcement Officers conducting security at event;
  Applicant to hire two (2) TCO’s from 3:00 pm – 7:00 pm for street closures; Applicant must
  coordinate with the Public Works Department on NO parking signage and any potential
  traffic safety measures that maybe needed for street closure; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State Health Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00385481).

Item #5:  Andrew A. Henderson on behalf of Families for Children Inc., to host a Client
  ThanksgivingCelebration Event on 4th Avenue by the parking area at the front of the
  agency, on Manchester Blvd, right before the alleyway, on Wednesday, November 27,
  2024, from 10:00 am – 1:00 pm;APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for one (1) day event on 4th Ave; Applicant to
  hire a min of four (4) professional / licensed security guards for safety of attendees and
  volunteers; Applicant to hire two (2) TCO’s will be required from 9am – 3pm for street
  closures; IPD Watch Commander will be notified and extra will be provided as time
  permits;NO traffic congestion on Manchester, 4th Ave or surrounding street; Maintain site
  at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant
  and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State Health Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 0038530).

New Business License Request (s):

Item #6:  Stevn Weiner DBA Hot Section Retail, Inc. (X-Spot) to operate as Music Box at 10301 S.
  Hawthorne Blvd; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Approved as an existing use. Renewal of business license. Applicant
  must comply with all applicable IMC regulations.NO Live Entertainment (additional
  licensing required).ALL patrons / employees shall have valid identification to be inside and
  remain as an employee or paying customer at the location (Bar area only). **Valid ID shall
  be available upon request to any law enforcement or code enforcement officer(s).**NO
  possession, use or sales of ANY narcotics (including paraphernalia) in or outside of the
  location.Applicant shall post NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS in front / outside of
  the business as well. Proof (photos) must be submitted by applicant to Finance
  Department.The applicant or his / her designee are subject to random permit & license /
  establishment inspections at ANYTIME of the day or night, by any police or code
  enforcement officer(s), including California Department of Alcohol Beverage Control
  Investigators. The purpose of random inspections are to ensure that the listed
  establishments are adhering to the regulations set forth by the State of California Alcohol
  Beverage Control, City of Inglewood / Permits & Licensing committee.Adhere to all
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage, local, state and federal laws.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned
  will result in the revocation of your business license and any future business license
  application requests. motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00383285)

Item #7:  Stevn Weiner DBA Hot Section Retail, Inc. (X-Spot) to operate as Adult Video / Retail Store
  at 10301 S. Hawthorne Blvd; Approved Conditionally; Applicant to have entertainment
  video booths free of any doors or obstructions. Applicant shall ID all persons appearing to
  be under 25 years old. Underage persons, 17 years old or younger are strictly prohibited
  from the premises. Applicant and all employees shall routinely inspect video entertainment
 Permits & License Committee  October 24, 2024
Minutes  Page 4 of 6

  booths to ensure there is NO lewd activity or conduct being committed by the customers.
  Proper lighting is REQUIRED in and around all areas of this business, including exterior
  lighting outside the location (ie; parking lot). NO parties/events permitted at anytime inside
  or outside of the location (day or night), No loitering in or outside the establishment, NO
  consumption of any alcoholic beverages, No smoking or narcotic use (including cannabis
  activity) at anytime on the premises, NO body or bare skin touching of anykind. NO
  renovations or construction work without proper city permits and or the approval of City of
  Inglewood Code Enforcement Division. **In the interest of public safety, Applicant shall
  NOT employ any PC 290 sex registrant-offenders or anyone that would or has been
  known to be a threat or danger to the community.** This business is subjected to
  business compliance inspection(s) at anytime during business hours by any police (peace)
  officer or City of Inglewood code enforcement officer(s). Failure to comply with the
  conditions set forth by the City of Inglewood Permits & Licensing Committee will result in
  the immediate suspension and or revocation of this permit-license and any future licensing.
  Adhere to all local, state and federal laws. Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests. motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00382581)

Item #8:  Murphy’s Bowl, LLC DBA Intuit Dome to operate as Show/ Exhibit/ Special Event at 3930
  W. Century Blvd, APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of all business, admissions and parking tax by applicable due
  date; All outside events must be approved by the Permits and License Committee;Subject
  to inspection at any time during business hours by any Peace Officer, Code Enforcement
  Officer, or CA Department of Consumer Affairs employee;Owner and employees shall
  provide valid IDAll inside and outside Vendors operating on the property is required to
  register and file business tax with the City; andAdhere to all Federal, State, County laws
  and local Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future business license application
  requests.Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00385229).

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):

Item #9:  Jeffrey Psalms DBA Cuban Leaf Cigar Lounge to operate as Tobacco & Pipes at 122 S.
  Market St. This Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition
  set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood
  Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR
  BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all
  State and Federal Rules and Regulations; cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored
  E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges,
  Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless
  Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco,
  Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age
 Permits & License Committee  October 24, 2024

  21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall
  have a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age
  21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall
  have a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; MUST HAVE
  VALID ABC LICENSE TO SALE ALCOHOL; TO Sales or display of any type of weapons,
  i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited;Tobacco
  Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are subject to random
  Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police
  or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to enforce business
  establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood for
  Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization Tobacco
  Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within
  existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to
  minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco
  products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction of
  underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
  products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia
  per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also
  include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke / ingest
  illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and employees are
  expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,
  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.);Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying
  police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police
  response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement,
  Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); andThe following is not allowed inside
  the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee review and permit:
  PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, MUSIC BOXES (juke box),
  NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC.
  APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR
  NIGHT) OF OPERATION. motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00385432)
